title: Where attacks land
subtitle: Modern LLMs are built in stages. Knowing the stage tells you which attacks apply, and which defenses never see them.

steps.desc: Predict the next token over a huge corpus. **Lands here:** data poisoning at scale, backdoor implantation.
Further training on task-specific examples. **Lands here:** targeted poisoning, safety removal via fine-tuning.
Humans rank outputs; the model optimizes for preference. **Lands here:** preference-data poisoning, reward hacking.
The model serves requests. **Lands here:** prompt injection, jailbreaks, evasion, extraction.
Direct weight modification (ROME), no training at all. **Lands here:** model tampering, supply chain.

callout.label: Not everything is "poisoning".
callout.text: Data poisoning corrupts what goes in; fine-tuning and RLHF shape behavior through training; model editing is weight surgery on the finished model. PoisonGPT used editing, so data-provenance defenses never saw it: the shipped weights were the problem.
